verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin is a hosted autonomous research service, and an official CLI is a reasonable thing for a SaaS product to offer, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes web-based usage, credits and report generation, with no mention of a CLI. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec that might hint at programmatic tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
